confirm.note: Two handlers send it: `players` (one of two entry forms, by `is_pvp`) and `pets` (the raw values of `player.p.pets`). A third `emit("players")` with no payload is dead code (`if (0 && ...)`, node/server.js:4862-4866).

variants.name: Player list
variants.when: On a server that is not PvP. It leaves out characters in PvP areas (`is_in_pvp`).

variants.name: PvP server
variants.when: On a PvP server. It has every character, but hides `name`, `map` and the party name, and adds `kills`.

confirm.note: `kills` is set to 0 at login, so it is always present here.

variants.name: Pets
variants.when: The values of `player.p.pets`. No code in `node/` writes `p.pets`, so the list is empty, except for old saved data.

confirm.note: The items are whatever old saved data has in `player.p.pets` (`object`): no code in `node/` writes it, so the list is `[]` for any character created now.

senders.what: The `players` handler: every character on this server, you too.
